youtube.title: Marie Antoinette wore a WARSHIP in her hair. For real ⛵ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Marie Antoinette really wore a warship in her hair. ⛵ Rococo hairstyles got out of hand.

Iconic or insane? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1778 the French frigate Belle Poule won a sea battle, and Versailles celebrated with the "pouf à la Belle Poule": towering powdered hair topped with a model ship. Her hairdresser Léonard built poufs so tall that ladies had to kneel in their carriages.
